QuestInfo.name: Low on Wigs!
QuestInfo.0: #b#p9270060##k is terribly depressed about Blondie losing her wig. He's in desperate need of more #b#t4000467#s#k from #b#o9420529#s#k.
QuestInfo.1: #b#p9270060##k needs #b100#k more #b#t4000467#s#k from #b#o9420529#s#k to help Blondie. Hunting #b100 #o9420529#s#k is a tall order, but isn't it worth it to make Blondie happy again?
QuestInfo.2: #b#p9270060##k is so happy to see Blondie prancing along with her new golden wig. Maybe it will calm her down for a while.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: Able to proceed to the 'Missing Tires' quest.\n

0.0: BLONDIE!!! NOOO! DON'T SCRATCH OFF THAT WIG-- Too late! My poor kitty cat! She's bald and ugly again!
0.1: She's so self-destructive when she's upset. She's taking a nap in the warm sun, even though she KNOWS it'll give her wrinkles! Please, I'm all out of #b#t4000467#s#k. You have to get me more before she does something unthinkable!
0.2: All I need is for you to hunt #b100 #o9420529#s#k and bring back #b100 #t4000467#s#k. Do it for Blondie!

yes.0: Is Blondie stretching?! Oh no, oh no! You have to hurry. She only does that when she's REALLY upset!

1.0: Whew, Blondie is cute again. Thanks to you... And to my fine wig-making skills, of course.

yes.0: Blondie, stop... Stop that! Don't you dare touch that wig again or I'll lock you in the cellar with no dinner!

npc.0: You're not done yet? Think of Blondie!

item.0: I need more #b#t4000467#s#k than that if I'm to make a pretty wig for Blondie!

mob.0: You have to hunt more #b#o9420529#s#k than that. They're the only creatures around with hair lovely enough for my Blondie.
